# smol-toml, vendored

A TOML 1.0 parser, copied here so `timda` needs no `npm install`.

| Source | https://registry.npmjs.org/smol-toml/-/smol-toml-1.9.1.tgz |
| Integrity | `sha512-j7WyPdf0CJoutMzMoPLF/bVXHtKZIT9Rb4eGeEbWw8X2t5oirjPgpL+OpaENZrILYaXqYwnVH+qgUwVbl+pUJQ==` (matches the npm registry) |

What's here: the package's ES module build (`dist/*.js`), unchanged. Left out: the CommonJS build and the TypeScript declarations. It has no dependencies of its own and imports only its own files.

To update: download the new tarball, check its integrity against the registry, replace the `.js` files and `LICENSE`, and update this table.
